name: Spinner
description: A circular loading indicator that communicates an ongoing process. Respects prefers-reduced-motion by replacing the animation with a static circle. Uses role='status' and an accessible aria-label so screen readers announce the loading state.

notes: role='status' causes screen readers to announce the label without interrupting the user (live region with aria-live='polite').
aria-label defaults to 'Loading' and must always be provided — either via the default or an explicit override.
When prefers-reduced-motion is set the rotation animation is disabled and a static circle is shown instead.
The element is not interactive and never receives focus.

size.description: Controls the diameter of the spinner. xs=16px, sm=20px, md=32px, lg=48px.

aria-label.description: Accessible label announced by screen readers. Override when context requires a more descriptive phrase such as 'Saving changes'.

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the root element.

sizes.xs: 16px diameter — use only in extremely compact contexts such as inline button icons.
sizes.sm: 20px diameter — suitable for dense list rows or input adornments.
sizes.md: 32px diameter — default; suitable for most page-level loading states.
sizes.lg: 48px diameter — use for full-section or full-page loading states.

do: Always provide a meaningful aria-label when the default 'Loading' is not descriptive enough.
Use the lg size for full-page loading and xs/sm inside buttons or tight containers.
Pair with VisuallyHidden text if you need visible copy alongside the spinner.
dont: Do not use a Spinner for progress that can be quantified — use ProgressBar instead.
Do not apply inline styles — use the className prop and extend via CSS tokens.
Do not suppress the aria-label — every Spinner must have an accessible name.
